masterclass.name: Build a Multi-step AI Analysis Agent
masterclass.subtitle: A practical guide to building AI tools and agents
masterclass.description:
{"ops":[{"insert":"A practical guide to building AI tools and agents
"},{"attributes":{"link":"https://github.com/TeacherOp/skillgarage_1?tab=readme-ov-file"},"insert":"https://github.com/TeacherOp/skillgarage_1?tab=readme-ov-file"},{"insert":"

This was the kickoff to our AI tools and agents series with Neel Seth. The session focused on a single idea. You only need to understand one API call to build real AI automation. The entire session walked through how to go from a simple LLM request to a fully structured tool based agent that can run data analysis, call APIs, authenticate users, and chain multiple steps with high accuracy.

What you will learn in this session"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"
Neel started from scratch. A clean Python file. An empty IDE. One API key.

"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"He showed how to:"},{"insert":"
• Write the fundamental chat request to an LLM
• Add system prompts to define persona, tone, and output
• Format responses with precision
• Use the tools parameter to enforce strict structure
• Build reliable scripts that run at scale
• Analyse data with schema driven outputs
• Add third party tools like web search for accuracy and citations
• Chain tools to create real agents
• Move from scripts to production grade chatbots with authentication

Neel also shared the full repo with all scripts. You can download or clone it. Open it in VS Code or Cursor and follow along. The fastest way to learn is to copy the exact files and break them.

Highlights from the session"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"
Neel shared his own path. Three years of learning LLMs as a product manager. Over three lakh rupees spent on API keys. A shift from no code tools to full IDE based workflows. His view is clear. Tools like VS Code, Cursor, and Claude Code give you leverage that no code wrappers cannot. He also explained why Claude Code is worth the price if you want maximum speed and debugging clarity.

The live demo covered:"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"• A simple “hello claude” script
• Adding environment variables
• Using system prompts to reshape outputs
• Temperature and its real impact on reliability
• Why prompting for raw HTML or JSON is fragile
• Why tools solve this problem completely
• How to define schema with required fields
• How the model respects schema and stops adding stray text
• How to chain tools to simulate real workflows
• How to run bulk analysis using CSVs
• How to add web search for citations and factual grounding

He also walked through a full business use case. A platform needed to analyse hundreds of new technical skills. Normally a multi month project. With a structured tool based script, the entire analysis can run in minutes with citations and infrastructure needs clearly defined.

The session ended with a preview of how the same logic powers real chat based agents. Neel ran a Shopify support bot locally. It could authenticate a user, generate an OTP, verify it, and then fetch order details. All done through tools and a local Python server.

Resources included"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"• Github repo with all scripts
• Notes and full transcript
• Recording of the entire session
• Example tool definitions
• Example data analysis scripts
• Example agent server file

This series will help you build real agents that perform real work. Open the repo. Run the scripts. Break things. 
"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"The fastest way to learn is to ship something."},{"insert":"
"}]}
